# material-color-utilities (vendored)

Official Material Design 3 color library by Google (HCT color space,
tonal palettes, dynamic color schemes). Used by pixelGram for
Material You theming.

- Source: https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities
- Commit: bd811e4ca2ab94c4ce3cadc89c19b1820b9704b3
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE)
- Only the C++ sources are kept, tests and Bazel files are removed.
